architecture.mechanism: Membrane distillation driven by basin heat using water-vapor absorbent wicks to capture vapor and transfer latent heat, enabling cascading preheating of brine layers across multiple membrane stages.
architecture.intervention: Integrate multi-stage hydrophobic membrane distillation modules with absorbent wicking layers into the portable solar still, routing solar-heated feedwater sequentially through stages so that vapor passes through the membrane while concentrated brine is continuously swept away by the wick-mediated flow, preventing solute accumulation on the membrane surface without chemical agents.
architecture.expected_effect: Continuous removal of foulants via wick-driven brine transport and latent heat recovery maintains stable permeate flux over multi-day field operation without chemical cleaning.
architecture.falsification_test: Operate the modified unit and an unmodified control unit continuously for 72 hours using high-turbidity seawater; measure permeate flux hourly. The hypothesis is falsified if the integrated unit's flux declines by more than 15 percent relative to its initial value or requires chemical intervention to maintain output.
